segments.text: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered,
segments.speaker: The LORD
The LORD

segments.text: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: They are before my face.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text:
Their anger smolders all night.
In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Ephraim mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to Yahweh their God,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: nor sought him, for all this.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: They go to Assyria.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text:
Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue.
This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.
segments.speaker: The LORD
